en: A printed art postcard showing a colored reproduction of a historical painting of a riverside village with half-timbered houses and a large mill complex. The scene is pastoral: a river or mill pond in the mid‑ground with trees and a small dam or sluice, fields and distant hills in the background, and several traditional German-style buildings in the foreground. At the lower right margin is the artist credit and title, and a small printer's code appears at the lower left.
